name: Qasr al-Nur
_about: QASR AL-NUR, the Palace of Light: an original Persian garden palace ordered by water and light along one axis -- the entrance pishtaq and domed vestibule, the Court of Water (two-storey arcades with jali galleries, the reflecting pool mirroring the water gate between two wind-catchers), the four-iwan court with its fountain, the hammam (east) and the library (west), the chahar bagh with its sunken parterres, channels and domed octagonal pavilion, and on its terrace the audience hall: a cross of four vaulted arms under a double-shelled ribbed turquoise dome on a tiled drum of jali windows, its 30 m pishtaq framed by two minarets. Buff brick, cobalt and turquoise tile, white marble. Designed and generated by tools/archgen/qasr_al_nur.py (the design document is its docstring). +z is the front (south).
